subject.title: [Feature]: Option to skip tool list text in system prompt (reduce duplication)

question: Should OpenClaw add an off-by-default scoped config contract to suppress the human-readable Tooling list, or should this token reduction be handled only inside broader prompt/tool-schema optimization work?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix expands the supported config and prompt contract, and repo policy requires maintainer intent before adding another prompt knob.

options.title: Add Scoped Opt-In Config
options.body: Implement a narrow off-by-default option that omits only the Tooling list while keeping callable schemas and context diagnostics intact.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Token Work
options.body: Make the broader tool-schema/context optimization tracker own the product design and keep this issue as linked context until that plan lands.

options.title: Reject New Config Surface
options.body: Close this direction if maintainers decide existing tool profiles, Tool Search, and lean mode are the acceptable token-reduction surfaces.

recommendation.title: Add Scoped Opt-In Config
recommendation.body: Implement a narrow off-by-default option that omits only the Tooling list while keeping callable schemas and context diagnostics intact.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest inspected history on prompt construction and already reviewed this item in the issue discussion.
